profile_text.body:
Hesai Group, which does business as Hesai Technology, describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and a maker of lidar sensors. The company says its lidar hardware supports ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, and that it works with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide, with mass-produced lidars delivered to customers in over 40 countries. It describes lidar as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that enables features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot) along with advanced semi-autonomous driving.

For autonomous vehicles, the company says its sensors meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving and are aimed at robotaxis, robobuses, trucking, and industrial applications, with the goal of supporting large-scale autonomous fleet deployment.

Hesai Group is a for-profit public company headquartered in Shanghai and trades under the ticker HSAI. Its SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001861737. No litigation is recorded against it.
